paraphrase: At the last stage the citta becomes radiant and seemingly wondrous; this radiance is the lair of ignorance and must itself be investigated and destroyed — when it is, the pure citta remains, beyond conventions.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
